Name: Italian Countryside Farmhouse (Seasonal)
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ct9Ct7W.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center][size=3]Italian Countryside Farmhouse Mod transforms the vanilla farmhouse into a picturesque Italian countryside house that changes with the seasons. This mod is available for both Content Patcher, and Alternative Texture. [/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[size=3]This farmhouse mod is inspired by a picture I saw on Pinterest. For reference, here is the [/size][url=https://pin.it/7j1BZI3qY]link[/url][size=3].[/size]

[font=Times New Roman][size=5][b]﻿INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]Download this mod, Extract the mod file, and move the Extracted mod file to your Mods folder.[/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[font=Times New Roman][size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]- [AT]- Should be compatible with different AT Farmhouse Mods.[/size]
[size=3]- [CP]- Should be compatible with Building Mods as long as it doesn't change the Farmhouse.[/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[font=Times New Roman][size=5][b]NOTES[/b][/size][/font][/center]
[center][size=3]- This is a separate mod that I posted first before making the farm buildings overhaul, so if you want to change the look of your farm buildings download the overhaul one, otherwise download this one.[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]- I recommend downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Daisyniko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ as it fits the colors of the foliage I used.[/size]
[size=3]- Some parts of my Farmhouse are inspired by my favorite mods such as[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17656] Dustbeauty's Furniture Mod[/url]﻿, & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Gwenziack's Medieval Buildings[/url]﻿. [/size]
[size=3]- This is my first Farmhouse retexture mod so feel free in letting me know if there are any issues[/size]
[b][i][size=3]- TWICE Tzuyu Solo Debut Out on 09-06, 12 p.m KST  🏹[/size]
 [/i][/b][/center]
